reason: #939 made ControlAssistantWork.chat_detail and require_plan and ChatQueueService.get async, but ButlerAuthorityService.dispatch/_reconcile still called them without await, so every planned Butler Steer/Delegate/Act action raised AttributeError before dispatch, stayed planned, and the oversight loop recorded butler.project_replay_failed every 30 s (skipping recovery and memory capture). The fix awaits the four calls and types the work dependency so mypy sees them. Selected: test_butler_authority.py (repaired test-side awaits plus three new regressions, including the running oversight worker behind an authenticated Steer grant; 13 of its 16 tests fail on main because of this defect), test_butler_tool_failures.py (the third action trigger; its parent steer fails on main with the same AttributeError once the test awaits its own calls), and the unchanged suites around the oversight loop that pass on pristine origin/main under CI's warning flags: test_butler_recovery.py, test_butler_memory_pivotal.py, test_butler_capacity_retry.py, test_butler_project_roster.py, test_async_caller_boundaries.py and the 17 passing test_butler_oversight.py cases.
exclusions: test_butler_oversight.py::test_goal_transitions_commit_watch_and_project_events_then_close_after_replay, test_butler_review.py (14 failures), test_control_assistant_work.py (36 failures), test_butler_attention.py (2), test_butler_capabilities.py (1), test_butler_concurrent_recovery.py (1), test_butler_instructions.py (1) and test_goal_handoff.py (1) fail identically on pristine origin/main and on this branch for unrelated #939 leftovers (none reach butler_authority), so they are not selected. No UI, native or Playwright code changed; the operator journey (authority PUT, goal plan PATCH, Butler overview) was checked through the API on scratch supervisor PostgreSQL Cores on main and on this branch. PostgreSQL variants of the selected files run only where NEBULA_TEST_POSTGRES_URL is set; test_butler_authority.py was also run locally on PostgreSQL (16 passed).
